title: HOW MY TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODEL WORKS
goal: Explain how a latent diffusion model learns to undo noise and later generates an image from random noise conditioned on text.

lanes.label: TRAINING
flows: text embedding + noisy image -> 100M U-NET -> predict the noise -> compare + improve

lanes.label: GENERATING
flows: random noise + text embedding -> 100M U-NET -> remove noise, step by step -> new image

footer: Train it to undo noise. Then start from noise and let it draw.
output_doodles: a charming tiny fox-and-tree finished image labeled new image
